query:
SELECT id, state_code, state_name, candidate1_name, candidate1_party, candidate2_name, candidate2_party, status, primary_date, primary_runoff_date, rating 
FROM senate_races 
WHERE state_code IN ('AL', 'GA', 'OK', 'CA', 'LA')
ORDER BY state_code;
